tasks.title: Set up CI/CD pipeline
tasks.description: Configure GitHub Actions workflows for automated testing, linting, and deployment to staging and production environments.

tasks.title: Design database schema
tasks.description: Create entity-relationship diagram and finalize PostgreSQL schema for the core product tables.

tasks.title: Implement user authentication
tasks.description: Build JWT-based auth with refresh tokens. Include login, logout, register, and password reset flows.

tasks.title: Build dashboard UI
tasks.description: Create the main dashboard with metrics cards, charts, and a recent activity feed.

tasks.title: Write API documentation
tasks.description: Document all REST endpoints using OpenAPI 3.1 spec. Include request/response examples for each route.

tasks.title: Add pagination to list endpoints
tasks.description: Implement cursor-based pagination for /users, /projects, and /tasks endpoints. Default page size 25.

tasks.title: Performance audit
tasks.description: Run Lighthouse and Web Vitals audit on main pages. Target LCP < 2.5s, FID < 100ms, CLS < 0.1.

tasks.title: Set up error monitoring
tasks.description: Integrate Sentry for both frontend and backend. Configure alerts for p99 error rates above 1%.

tasks.title: Write unit tests for auth module
tasks.description: Achieve 90% coverage on the authentication module. Focus on token validation and refresh logic.

tasks.title: Mobile responsive layout
tasks.description: Ensure all pages are fully responsive for screens 320px and up. Test on iPhone SE, Pixel 5, iPad.

tasks.title: Implement rate limiting
tasks.description: Add Redis-backed rate limiting to public API endpoints. 100 req/min per IP, 1000 req/min per authenticated user.

tasks.title: Code review process documentation
tasks.description: Write team guidelines for PR size, review turnaround time, and merge requirements.
